_comment: Copy this file to <ROM-ID>_<CAL-ID>.json for a new bin/market/model. rom.path is relative to the repo root; sha256 is verified at load (see binaries/manifest.csv for own dumps). market/model/variant describe the vehicle this bin came from and drive which peripherals/pins exist. Register bases per docs/references/Sh7055h.pdf; cross-check against reverse-engineered/decompiled/<rom-id>/symbols.tsv.
name: TEMPLATE

config._note: DMAC per symbols.tsv (DMAOR 0xffffecb0, ch0 SAR/DAR/DMATCR/CHCR 0xffffecc0-0xffffeccc). CHCR DE write -> immediate transfer + TE.

pins.note: connector-terminal <-> signal map; package-pin hop is board routing (unresolved)

sensors._comment: scripted inputs injected via ADC/GPIO reads, e.g. coolant temp, MAF, RPM

uds._note: ROM-specific entry points (60E15120_N3J1E): FUN_00011d88 CAN RX poll (descs 0x4dfec/0x4dffc -> UDS RX buffer 0xffffddc8), FUN_000680a0(0x7e0) UDS service entry, FUN_00003c2a task dispatcher (idle 0x3dac), diag22 dispatch 0x5774c (table 0x5f10c), TX descriptor 0x4e00c (id 0x7e8, mb 15, buf 0xffffddd0). OS tick timer not yet modeled (E6) - the OBD port drives these directly. Label the equivalents per ROM before using the port with another bin.
